items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: So Earl Barnes couldn't make it. So he liked the way I played, so he sent me to be Earl Barnes.

ctx.x: There was a guy that lived not too far from me. He lived on, uh, St. Anne Street off of Galvestre, but I was a guy that lived on St. Anne Street off of Galvestre. He lived on St. Anne Street off of Galvestre. By the name of, uh, Earl Barnes. Mm-hmm. Great saxophone player. He played the solo on that record. On Good Rockin' Night, yeah. So what happened, there's a promoter out of, I think, of Mississippi, or somewhere, Texas or something, that wanted to hire, see, that during that time you could, you could just…
